title: Build PumpStation as a simulation-only community capital institution
problem: The baseline repository described coordinated memecoin buying, promotion, and automated exits, while the founder now requires an evidence-bound institution in which models reason, agents propose, authorized humans decide, and only the UNIIMENTE Kernel may permit external consequences.
baseline: At commit df6a732, PumpStation's README proposed real-time memecoin coordination, community-driven price movements, voting on buys, and automated exits. The executable code provided a replayable fixed-message wallet login and a small client/server shell.

alternatives.name: Documentation-only research project
alternatives.description: Replace the README and publish educational material without an executable institutional control plane.
advantages: Avoids implying that the prototype is ready for capital
disadvantages: Cannot test evidence completeness, dissent preservation, authority boundaries, or replay
Leaves safety claims as prose rather than executable refusals
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive if the executable Stage 0 system adds maintenance burden without producing measurable evidence-quality or safety gains.

alternatives.name: Centralized analyst service
alternatives.description: Use one AI analyst, a conventional database, and direct human review without a multi-role deliberation model.
advantages: Simpler operation and lower model cost
disadvantages: May omit adversarial, legal, security, or community-impact perspectives
alternatives.revival_evidence: Prefer this design if held-out comparisons match the multi-role design on decision quality, evidence, fraud detection, and participant protection at materially lower cost.

alternatives.name: Full distributed agent platform
alternatives.description: Build autonomous agent orchestration, distributed storage, on-chain governance, and execution-ready integrations now.
advantages: Could support later scale and specialist autonomy
disadvantages: Prematurely expands the authority and attack surface
Adds expense and complexity before the product wedge is proven
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive components only when a named verifier, measured bottleneck, approved stage, and constitutional review justify each dependency.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The tiny baseline remains inexpensive but keeps an unsafe and strategically weak public product definition with no institutional learning system.
disadvantages: Does not test the founder's productive-capital thesis

roles.position: Preserve the community ownership mission while replacing price engineering with productive-asset capability.
material_concerns: The redesign could overcorrect into a generic compliance application
Future contributors could treat agent agreement as authority

roles.position: Use one local event spine and typed contracts as the Stage 0 source of institutional truth.
Assume coordinated narratives, classifier evasion, key compromise, and evidence laundering.
material_concerns: Hashes can be mistaken for truth
A founder signature can be mistaken for a Kernel permit

roles.position: Keep one Node process, one static client, and a reversible append-only store for Stage 0.
material_concerns: Governance artifacts can overwhelm the codebase
Local JSONL is not a production durability boundary

roles.position: Protect immigrant participants from affinity pressure and preserve counterevidence and dissent.
material_concerns: Synthetic fixtures could be marketed as performance

evidence.claim: The baseline actively described coordinated buying, promotion, and exits.
evidence.finding: The public product definition explicitly relied on community-driven memecoin price activity.

evidence.claim: The canonical UNIIMENTE design reserves external consequences to one Kernel path.
evidence.reference: UNIIMENTE Reality Compiler Blueprint.pdf and Proof to Settlement Egregore.pdf
evidence.finding: The supplied architecture separates reasoning, proposals, authorized decisions, consequence gating, receipts, and reality reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Countdown buying and organizer-first exits are recognized pump-and-dump patterns.
evidence.finding: The advisory supports hard refusal of coordinated price-movement instructions and exits.

evidence.claim: Affinity fraud can exploit trust within immigrant and ethnic communities.
evidence.finding: Community identity cannot substitute for independent diligence, disclosures, and non-coercive consent.

evidence.claim: Stage 0 can expose typed research and simulation without a financial execution adapter.
evidence.finding: The local architecture contains intake, deliberation, simulation, and refusal surfaces but no order, transfer, deposit, custody, or promotion adapter.

counterevidence.claim: A multi-agent design materially outperforms simpler systems.
counterevidence.finding: Synthetic fixtures cannot establish real decision advantage, so complexity remains unearned.

counterevidence.claim: A local hash chain proves the underlying claims are true.
counterevidence.finding: The chain can reveal in-file alteration but cannot prove semantic truth or prevent wholesale replacement.

counterevidence.claim: Wallet authentication establishes a participant's legal identity or suitability.
counterevidence.finding: Cryptographic verification and credential validity do not by themselves establish truth or authorization.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Give ordinary people institutional-grade research, fraud protection, productive-ownership analysis, and preserved learning without creating capital, promotion, custody, or trading authority.

advantages.statement: Replace later-buyer dependence with productive value, underwriting, and institutional memory.
advantages.amplified_value: Each reviewed opportunity can improve reusable evidence standards, risk models, and community capability.

advantages.statement: Create one explicit authority path from proposal to authorized human decision to future Kernel permit.
advantages.amplified_value: Agents can collaborate broadly without consensus silently becoming authority.

advantages.statement: Preserve evidence, counterevidence, dissent, corrections, and negative outcomes additively.
advantages.amplified_value: The institution can learn from mistakes instead of optimizing its narrative.

advantages.statement: Use visible conflicts and affinity-pressure prohibitions to protect community participants.
advantages.amplified_value: Trust becomes an input to collaboration, not a substitute for diligence.

advantages.statement: Test the architecture with one small executable system before distributed infrastructure.
advantages.amplified_value: Capital and engineering remain focused on the evidence bottleneck.

disadvantages.statement: Deterministic manipulation rules can create false confidence.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Classifier failure refuses by default, rules are documented as incomplete, and measured false positives and false negatives gate Stage 1.

disadvantages.statement: Governance bureaucracy can overwhelm a tiny codebase.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Use one ledger, one deliberation, one ADR, and machine-readable contracts without building a committee workflow engine.

disadvantages.statement: A local JSONL history can be deleted, truncated, or rolled back.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Hash the event chain, disarm on integrity failure, preserve recovery steps, and defer external anchoring until a named verifier exists.

disadvantages.statement: Wallet identity excludes non-crypto participants and does not prove legal identity.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep wallet identity optional and identity-only in Stage 0; leave Stage 1 identity and recovery as explicit unresolved decisions.

disadvantages.statement: Multi-agent review may cost more without producing better decisions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Compare it with a centralized analyst, deterministic rules, and a passive benchmark while leaving the complexity gate NOT_EARNED.

disadvantages.statement: A founder-only decision can centralize failure and create key risk.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: A founder approval can only produce an awaiting-Kernel packet and cannot activate a stage or external effect.

disadvantages.statement: A public fork can remove the safeguards.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Do not claim the license prevents misuse; make future canonical operation, approvals, and receipts independently inspectable.

comparisons.baseline: Fastest path to visible activity but constitutionally incompatible because it depends on coordinated market behavior.
comparisons.do_nothing: Lowest immediate cost and risk but preserves an unsafe product definition and produces no institutional evidence.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Education-only documentation avoids execution risk but cannot test preservation, replay, refusal, or authority behavior.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: One centralized analyst is cheaper and easier to maintain and remains the benchmark the multi-role design must beat.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Implement Stage 0 on a dedicated branch using only synthetic fixtures, with no external-effect adapter and a one-commit rollback.

rejected_alternatives.name: Blockchain-first implementation
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: No Stage 0 private research, event, or simulation need requires a chain.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A named verifier must require a public proof anchor, ownership record, or settlement receipt.

rejected_alternatives.name: Live-capital pilot
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: It violates the authorized operating stage and creates unresolved legal, custody, accounting, and consequence risks.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Only a new constitutional decision with counsel, explicit founder authorization, complete stage evidence, and a canonical Kernel permit can reconsider it.

rejected_alternatives.name: Autonomous agent swarm
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: The repository has no evidence that distributed autonomy improves outcomes and it would expand authority and attack surfaces.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Held-out comparisons must show that simpler systems fail materially and that each added component has a bounded owner and authority.

pass_2.attack_summary: Pass 1 reduced financial danger but created a miniature constitutional system around a tiny prototype. Hashes could be mistaken for truth, a founder boundary could be theatrical without a real Kernel, keyword rules could be gamed, and a polished dashboard could overstate maturity.

new_weaknesses.statement: Contributors may update prose instead of executable truth.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Link documents to canonical schemas and control files and validate required behavior in tests.

new_weaknesses.statement: One process and one local event file create a single failure domain.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Accept that boundary only for Stage 0 and name production persistence and independent anchoring as unresolved.

new_weaknesses.statement: Abstract institutional terms can obscure the current simple product.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Lead every relevant screen and README section with current executable capabilities and explicit non-capabilities.

new_weaknesses.statement: Keyword rules can be evaded or can misclassify critical discussion as instruction.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Combine structured disclosures with fail-closed text screening and keep bear, legal, security, complaint, and education discussion from becoming action instructions.

new_weaknesses.statement: A future Kernel boundary could become a fictional placeholder.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Report the Kernel connection as not implemented and expose no permit endpoint, activation route, or execution adapter.

new_weaknesses.statement: Synthetic fixtures can be shaped to favor the multi-agent design.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep the complexity decision NOT_EARNED regardless of fixture score and require held-out independently reviewed work.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Rules are a Stage 0 refusal layer, not proof of safety, and advancement requires measured error rates.
The minimum artifact set is bounded to one ledger, one deliberation, one ADR, schemas, and executable checks.
The local store is explicitly non-production and fails closed on detected chain corruption.
Stage 0 does not require wallet use; inclusive identity and recovery must be designed with actual pilot participants.
The four-system comparison is implemented but fixture output cannot earn production complexity.
Founder approval is prevented from activating stages or external consequences and no local actor can substitute for the Kernel.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any requested stage activation or external-effect integration

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Open-source safeguards cannot prevent unsafe forks; canonical receipts and transparent operation are the appropriate future control.

pass_2.final_design: Use one Node service, one static dashboard, strict opportunity and deliberation schemas, one hash-chained event store, nonce-bound identity, deterministic fail-closed manipulation screening, a proposal-only decision compiler, and hash-bound stage packets. Implement no execution adapter, stage activator, exchange dependency, private-key setting, deposit route, custody path, or public promotion system. Treat the experiment as fixture evidence only and keep multi-agent complexity unearned.

residual_risks.risk: Novel or multilingual manipulation may evade deterministic patterns.
residual_risks.mitigation: Require adversarial human review and measured classifier errors before Stage 1.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Every rejected, appealed, or escaped case

residual_risks.risk: Founder wallet compromise could create a false founder approval.
residual_risks.mitigation: Founder approval cannot activate a stage and future production approval needs stronger recovery and Kernel verification.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Before deployment outside a local sandbox

residual_risks.risk: The local event history can be replaced wholesale.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep Stage 0 non-production and add independent anchoring only when a verifier and privacy model are named.
Keep money, execution, offers, custody, outside capital, and public owned-asset promotion absent.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Before Stage 2 or any Stage 3 authorization

residual_risks.risk: The interface could imply operational maturity.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep permanent simulation warnings and explicit evidence tiers on every relevant screen and result.

dissent.handling: The dissent is preserved in the ADR and experiment contract. Stage 0 may run because no external consequence is possible, but the multi-agent complexity gate remains NOT_EARNED.

entries.position: Do not treat the ten-role design as justified by repository size or synthetic results.
entries.rationale: There is no real outcome evidence that multi-agent deliberation outperforms a centralized analyst or deterministic rules.
entries.evidence_threshold: Material outperformance on held-out, independently reviewed opportunities with zero policy violations and measured participant-harm outcomes.

migration_plan: Implement on agent/community-capital-institution, preserve Git history and useful wallet authentication structure, remove active coordinated-market behavior, publish a draft PR, and leave stale PR branches untouched.

steps: Close the draft pull request without merging
Revert the migration commit if it has been merged later
Preserve generated event logs and experiment results as evidence
Restore operation only after the constitutional defect is corrected and re-reviewed

kill_criteria: Any agent self-approval or authority expansion
Any stage activation without a canonical Kernel permit
Any silent history deletion or alteration
Classifier failure that defaults toward execution
Any claim that fixture output is real performance
review_trigger: First held-out experiment, any Stage 1 request, any proposed external-effect integration, or availability of canonical UNIIMENTE Kernel contracts
